_role: Versions the policy kernel and names the layers that carry authority. Non-normative by itself: it records which files are authoritative, it does not grant authority.

registry.authority: durable topology, surfaces, routes, probes, storage roots

status.authority: observed readiness, live bindings, known issues, liveness

control.authority: delegation policy, worker entrypoints, checkpoint rules, scheduler definitions, drift policy

audit.authority: historical evidence only, never a current-state source

compatibility_shims.note: Retained so old links resolve. New capability policy and factual authority must not be placed here.

notes: A generated view is repaired at its canonical source and regenerated, never patched in place.
This manifest declares which files are authoritative; it does not control what the runtime injects into a session.
Changing cutover_state or generated_views_state is an authority flip: record it in POLICY_CHANGELOG.md and start a fresh session before the next execution slice.
